name: Compute summary statistics of diffusion measures from subcortical segmentation
summary: Computes mean diffusion measures (DTI, optional NODDI) and volume within each FreeSurfer aseg subcortical structure with mri_segstats and outputs a parc-stats CSV.
description: Resamples each diffusion measure into the FreeSurfer ribbon space (mri_vol2vol --regheader) and runs mri_segstats with the aseg segmentation to summarise every subcortical structure, then tabulates the results in aseg_nodes.csv. Use it to get per-structure tract-independent diffusion statistics. The diffusion measures must be in register with the FreeSurfer anatomy (header-based alignment). The README also lists myelin-map and qMRI inputs; the stats script loops only over the DTI/DKI and NODDI measures.

inputs.description: Output directory of FreeSurfer recon-all for the subject.
DTI (and optionally DKI) measures such as FA, MD, RD and AD.
inputs.requirements: Must be aligned with the FreeSurfer anatomy; resampling uses header information only.

inputs.description: Optional quantitative MRI maps (T1, R1, M0, PD, MTV, VIP, SIR, WF).

outputs.description: aseg_nodes.csv with volume and mean measure values per subcortical structure.
Intermediate mri_segstats summaries (.sum) and per-measure text/CSV tables.

citations.text: Avesani P, McPherson B, Hayashi S, et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).
Dale AM, Fischl B, Sereno MI. Cortical surface-based analysis. I. Segmentation and surface reconstruction. NeuroImage 9, 179-194 (1999).

failure_modes.message: stats computation failed. check derivatives and error log
failure_modes.cause: mri_segstats did not produce a summary for a measure.
failure_modes.fix: Check the measure images are valid and aligned with the FreeSurfer anatomy.
Provide a FreeSurfer license in the FREESURFER_LICENSE environment variable.
